note: Absolute forecast error as a percentage of monthly revenue, over 12 backtests per scenario (4 sellers x 30/45/60-day horizons). 'baseline' uses data generated by the same process the forecaster assumes, so it is a consistency check rather than evidence of real-world accuracy. The other rows deliberately break an assumption. Late payouts are the dominant sensitivity: one delayed payout moves a whole payment across the measured date. The what-if simulator's 'payouts arrive late' setting exists so a seller can test exactly this on their own projection.
